title: Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer: A Multi-Agent Framework with Perspective-Based Refinement for Qualitative Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2605.24600v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for qualitative data analysis (QDA), yet their outputs often miss the depth and nuance of human analysis. We argue this gap reflects a missing credibility practice from human QDA: peer debriefing, in which an analyst seeks feedback from a disinterested peer and uses it to refine their coding. To bring this practice into LLM-assisted QDA, we propose Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer, a multi-agent QDA framework that builds peer debriefing into key coding steps. In our framework, a Hierarchical Coding Agent follows the standard QDA process to generate codes, sub-themes, and themes, along with self-explanations and reflection memos. It then shares these outputs with three Peer-Debriefing Agents, each applying a distinct analytical perspective (Theory-Driven, Data-Driven, or Applied) and refining the codes by keeping, renaming, reassigning, merging, or splitting them. These perspectives are drawn

translated_title: Agent作为同行评议者：一种具有基于视角精炼机制的多智能体定性分析框架
translated_abstract: 大型语言模型（LLM）越来越多地被用于定性数据分析（QDA），但其输出往往缺乏人类分析的深度与细腻度。我们认为这种差距反映了人类QDA中缺失的一种可信度实践：同行评议，即分析者从无利益相关的同行处寻求反馈，并利用该反馈来完善其编码。为了将这一实践引入LLM辅助的QDA，我们提出了Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer，这是一个将同行评议融入关键编码步骤的多智能体QDA框架。在该框架中，分层编码智能体遵循标准QDA流程生成编码、子主题和主题，并附带自我解释和反思备忘录。随后，它将这些输出分享给三个同行评议智能体，每个智能体采用不同的分析视角（理论驱动、数据驱动或应用型），并通过保留、重命名、重新分配、合并或拆分编码来对其进行精炼。这些视角源自……
tldr: 该论文提出Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer多智能体框架，将人类定性分析中的“同行评议”可信度实践引入LLM辅助的定性数据分析，由具有不同分析视角（理论驱动、数据驱动、应用型）的评议智能体对编码智能体的编码结果进行保留、重命名、合并等精炼，从而提升分析结果的深度与可信度。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes Agent-as-Peer-Debriefer, a multi-agent framework that embeds the human QDA credibility practice of peer debriefing into LLM-assisted qualitative analysis, where peer agents with distinct analytical perspectives (theory-driven, data-driven, or applied) refine the coding agent's results to enhance depth and credibility.
